name: Hermes-3-Llama-3.1-8B
notes: Architecture identical to Meta-Llama-3.1-8B (hidden 4096, 32 layers, 32 query heads / 8 KV heads, rope_theta 500000, 131072 native context); only the weights differ. This is the most-downloaded fine-tune in the Hermes line (~403k monthly downloads at the access date) and the de-facto default local assistant model on llama.cpp. head_dim derived as 4096 / 32 = 128; gqa_ratio = 4.KV bytes/token at bf16 (2 bytes/element): 32 layers x 8 KV heads x 128 head_dim x 2 (K and V) x 2 bytes = 131072 B/token = 128.0 KiB/token. At 128k context that is 16.00 GiB of KV per sequence at bf16, so KV quantisation (--cache-type-k q8_0) is the usual lever rather than weight quantisation. context_scaling is null: context length is native to the pretrained config, no rope_scaling.
